Package CPDFGeneration

Class CConverterProperties

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CConverterProperties
public class CConverterProperties extends Object
Native-backed page, resource, font and print settings for PDF conversion. Keep this object and its font provider valid and unchanged while a conversion uses them, and call release() when no longer needed.

  • Method Details

    • release

      public void release()
      Release a CConverterProperties object. Repeated calls are harmless. Email conversions borrow this object under the same lock, so release waits for an active email use to finish.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if called reentrantly from an email callback

      public void setBaseUri(String baseUri)
      Set the base URI for resolving relative paths in HTML. The base URI is used to resolve relative URLs for resources like images, CSS, and links.

    • setPageMargins

      public void setPageMargins(int top, int right, int bottom, int left)
      Set repeating page margins in CSS pixels, in top/right/bottom/left order. Margins explicitly specified by the document's CSS @page rules take precedence. These values use CSS pixels, unlike page sizes in points.
      Parameters:
      top - nonnegative top margin in CSS pixels
      right - nonnegative right margin in CSS pixels
      bottom - nonnegative bottom margin in CSS pixels
      left - nonnegative left margin in CSS pixels
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any margin is negative or properties have been released
      Since:
      1.3.0

    • getPageMargins

      public int[] getPageMargins()
      Read the configured page margins. Modifying the returned array does not change these properties; use setPageMargins(int, int, int, int) to update them.
      Returns:
      a new four-element array in top/right/bottom/left order, measured in CSS pixels, or null if the properties have been released
      Since:
      1.3.0

    • setHeaderFooterOptions

      public void setHeaderFooterOptions(CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions options)
      Copy header/footer templates and their rendering metadata into these properties. Later changes to the supplied object do not update the native configuration. Null string fields are treated as empty strings.
      Parameters:
      options - header/footer configuration to copy
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if options are null, either skip count is negative, or the properties have been released
      Since:
      1.3.0

    • getHeaderFooterOptions

      public CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions getHeaderFooterOptions()
      Read a copy of the current header/footer configuration. Changes to the returned object take effect only after calling setHeaderFooterOptions(CHtmlHeaderFooterOptions).
      Returns:
      an independent header/footer configuration object
      Since:
      1.3.0

    • setFontProvider

      public void setFontProvider(CFontProvider fontProvider)
      Set the font provider for custom font support. The font provider supplies custom fonts for rendering text in the PDF. The ownership of the FontProvider is not transferred.
      Parameters:
      fontProvider - CFontProvider object.
